name: Tahu Isi
steps: Cut tofu into eight thick rectangles; blot dry and pan-sear lightly so they hold shape. Cut a pocket into one side of each without slicing through.
Finely shred carrot and cabbage. Stir-fry with garlic, sprouts and spring onion for 3 minutes; season with soy sauce and cool completely.
Stuff the tofu pockets firmly but without tearing. Whisk both flours, salt and cold water into a smooth coating batter.
Dip stuffed tofu in batter and fry at 175°C in batches for 4–5 minutes until crisp and golden. Drain and serve hot.
tips: Cool and drain the vegetables before stuffing so steam and moisture do not split the tofu pockets.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
